text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert — canary failure spike for inference-service (canary: kms-rollout)
incident-bot: 5xx rate up to 42% in the last 3m. Latency within SLOs. Suspect secrets/config issues during recent canary.
elaine: I'm on call, looking at canary logs. tagging mike/ryan.
mike: logs show repeated KMS Decrypt denied errors in canary pods. sample: ```
2026-03-15T02:14:07Z inference-canary-1 error KMSError: AccessDenied for arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111111:key/abcd-ef01 - operation: Decrypt - principal: arn:aws:sts::111111:assumed-role/redwood-service-role
```
ryan: that aligns with the new env var KMS_KEY=alias/new-rollout-key from the deploy earlier. Looks like key rotation happened but nobody updated key grants for the service role.
sofia: customer impact?
support-lead: ~10 orgs seeing 503/500 spikes; mostly small/trial orgs but ticket thread count doubling. No major customers yet.
mike: we need immediate mitigation: kill the LD flag for the rollout and/or revert the canary env var. LD kill is quickest to stop new traffic hitting the problematic path. I'll attempt LD kill and then trigger a k8s rollback if needed.
launchdarkly-bot: Command queued — kill flag new-kms-rollout (actor: mike). Propagated to 95% of environments.
mike: also executing: ```kubectl set env deployment/inference-canary KMS_KEY=alias/old-canary-key -n prod```
deploy-bot: Set env on deployment/inference-canary in prod. New pods creating. Expected stabilization ~4m.
ryan: while that's happening, we should not change IAM in prod without verification. Plan: 1) revert env var in canary (done), 2) patch grants in a controlled change with a staging test, 3) add CI preflight to validate decrypt for any new key alias used in a deploy.
elaine: agreed. mike confirm canary pod decrypt logs after env revert.
mike: update: new canary pods show successful decrypts and requests returning 200. Error rate dropped to ~6% (was 42%).
incident-bot: error rate back to baseline (6%) over last 5m. Canary errors mitigated.
support-lead: sending customer update: "Investigating elevated errors for inference calls; mitigation applied (canary rollback). Engineering investigating root cause (KMS permission mismatch). We'll follow up with timeline and actions."
elaine: I'm going to hand this to night oncall @sofia for post-incident follow-up and postmortem. sofia: own the IAM grant change, CI guard, and write the postmortem.
sofia: taking ownership. I'll coordinate with ryan to prepare the IAM change and run through staging tests. scheduling a 09:30 PST blameless debrief.
ryan: I'll prepare an IAM diff and a small integration test: assume-role with service role creds -> kms:Decrypt on new key. Add this test to the deploy pipeline as a gate.
mike: filed ENG-4921: "Add KMS preflight check + prevent key alias misconfigures in deploys" and linked this thread.
elaine: great. keep monitoring for 30m then close. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigated. Duration ~19m.
sofia: noted, will run postmortem template and update incident log with timeline and action items.
